code:
# pip install tiktoken
import tiktoken
enc = tiktoken.get_encoding("cl100k_base")

for word in ["lowest", "strawberry", "Collegeville", "CS357", "internationalization"]:
    ids = enc.encode(word)
    pieces = [enc.decode([i]) for i in ids]
    print(f"{word:22s} -> {len(ids)} tokens  {pieces}")
description: A tokenizer divides text into pieces represented by numeric IDs. You can read how this example compares those pieces across the supplied words.

steps.description: The comment names the needed package. The code imports tiktoken and selects the cl100k_base encoding.
The loop visits five supplied strings. encode converts each string into a sequence of token IDs.
The list comprehension decodes one token ID at a time so you can inspect its text piece.
The formatted line pairs the original string with its token count and pieces. Compare those pieces with the page's hand-traced example.
